# Generated by tools/build_managers.py.
# The Records: one line of a log, for the country in scope. The caller has set the temporary variables
# ev_kind, ev_fam, ev_kid and one for each part of a line (tools/build_records.py, fill()). The oldest line goes past 1000.
# Each kind of line is counted (mod1440_ct), a line of the territory log in that log only.
mod1440_ev_add = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_ln_next = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_id = mod1440_ln_next }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_kind = ev_kind }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_fam = ev_fam }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_a = ev_a }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_b = ev_b }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sa = ev_sa }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sb = ev_sb }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_c = ev_o }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_sc = ev_so }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_p = ev_p }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_x = ev_x }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_k = 0 }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_id = ev_id }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_n = ev_n }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_date^num > 1000 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_kind index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_fam index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_a index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_b index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sb index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_c index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sc index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_p index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_x index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_k index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_id index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_ev_n index = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { AND = { check_variable = { ev_fam = 2 } check_variable = { ev_x = 1 } } } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 60
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 60 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^ev_kid = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 2 } }
		var:ev_a = {
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 3 } }
		var:ev_p = {
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } } }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_new = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_fam = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_new_war = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_k = ev_kind }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_d = global.date }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_n = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sb = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_n = ev_b }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 1 } check_variable = { ev_sa = 2 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_n = ev_a }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_n = ev_p }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_a }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_so = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_o }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
}

mod1440_tr_add = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ev_x = 1 } } }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_ln_next = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_id = mod1440_ln_next }
	}
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_date = global.date }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_day = global.num_days }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_kind = ev_kind }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_fam = ev_fam }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_a = ev_a }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_b = ev_b }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sa = ev_sa }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sb = ev_sb }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_c = ev_o }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_sc = ev_so }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_p = ev_p }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_x = ev_x }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_k = 0 }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_id = ev_id }
	add_to_array = { mod1440_tr_n = ev_n }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_date^num > 1000 } }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_date index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_day index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_kind index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_fam index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_a index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_b index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sa index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sb index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_c index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sc index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_p index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_x index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_k index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_id index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_tr_n index = 0 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 60
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 60 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^ev_kid = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ev_x = 1 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 2 } }
			var:ev_a = {
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 3 } }
			var:ev_p = {
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_sr_lines = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_sa = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_a }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ev_so = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = ev_o }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
}

# The Records: a game saved before a line had an officer has logs without the newer parts. They get a 0 for
# each line that is there, and a capital in the territory log the mark that it stands in the main log too.
mod1440_ev_grow = {
	mod1440_tk_check = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_x^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_c^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_c value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_sc value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_p^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_p value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_x^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_x value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_id^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_k^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_k value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_id^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_v = mod1440_ev_id^num }
				add_to_temp_variable = { gr_v = 1 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { gr_v = -1 }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_id value = gr_v index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_c^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_c value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_sc value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_p^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_p value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_x value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { gr_taken = token:mod1440_ev_capital_taken }
		set_temp_variable = { gr_lost = token:mod1440_ev_capital_lost }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_tr_kind
			value = gr_k
			index = gr_i
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { gr_k = gr_taken } check_variable = { gr_k = gr_lost } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^gr_i = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_id^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_k^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_k value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_id^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_v = mod1440_tr_id^num }
				add_to_temp_variable = { gr_v = 5001 }
				multiply_temp_variable = { gr_v = -1 }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_id value = gr_v index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_n^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_n^num < mod1440_ev_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_ev_n value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_n^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_n^num < mod1440_tr_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_tr_n value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_n^num < mod1440_kp_date^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 1000
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_n^num < mod1440_kp_date^num } }
				add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_n value = 0 index = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_v = 2 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_v = 2 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_seen = mod1440_ln_next }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_new_war = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_n = THIS }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_k = token:mod1440_blank }
		set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_d = global.date }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_v = 1 } } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_v = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_sea = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_air = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_vp = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto_n = mod1440_hn_count }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_cite_n = 0 }
	}
}

# The Records: which rows of a list are striped: 0, 1, 0, 1 ... for 512 rows.
mod1440_rec_odd = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_odd^num < 512 } }
		set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 512
			value = odd_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_odd^num < 512 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_odd = odd_v }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { odd_v = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { odd_v = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Records: the text keys a save keeps (tools/build_records.py, kept_tokens()). k: 60 keys, v: 2082 keys.
mod1440_tk_now_k = {
	clear_temp_array = tk_kn
	clear_temp_array = tk_kc
	add_to_temp_array = { tk_kn = token:mod1440_ev_begins }
	add_to_temp_array = { tk_kc = 0 }
	add_to_temp_array = { tk_kn = token:mod1440_ev_war_on }
	add_to_temp_array = { tk_kc = 1 }
	add_to_temp_array = { tk_kn = token:mod1440_ev_war_by }

mod1440_tk_map_k = {
	set_temp_variable = { tk_r = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { tk_brk = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_tk_k
		value = tk_o
		index = tk_j
		break = tk_brk
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { tk_o = tk_v } }
			set_temp_variable = { tk_c = mod1440_tk_kc^tk_j }
			set_temp_variable = { tk_b2 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_j < tk_kc^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_o2 = tk_kc^tk_j }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_o2 = tk_c } }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_r = tk_kn^tk_j }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_b2 = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_b2 = 0 } }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = tk_kc
					value = tk_o2
					index = tk_j2
					break = tk_b2
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { tk_o2 = tk_c } }
						set_temp_variable = { tk_r = tk_kn^tk_j2 }
						set_temp_variable = { tk_b2 = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { tk_brk = 1 }
		}
	}
}
mod1440_tk_map_v = {
	set_temp_variable = { tk_r = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { tk_brk = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_tk_v
		value = tk_o
		index = tk_j
		break = tk_brk
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { tk_o = tk_v } }
			set_temp_variable = { tk_c = mod1440_tk_vc^tk_j }
			set_temp_variable = { tk_b2 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_j < tk_vc^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_o2 = tk_vc^tk_j }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_o2 = tk_c } }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_r = tk_vn^tk_j }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_b2 = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_b2 = 0 } }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = tk_vc
					value = tk_o2
					index = tk_j2
					break = tk_b2
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { tk_o2 = tk_c } }
						set_temp_variable = { tk_r = tk_vn^tk_j2 }
						set_temp_variable = { tk_b2 = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { tk_brk = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# The Records: for the country in scope, whether the numbers of the kept keys are still today's (the version of
# the list, then every key of the kinds and every 16th name of a point). If not, mod1440_tk_fix.
mod1440_tk_check = {
	set_temp_variable = { tk_bad = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tk_ver = 588685 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { tk_bad = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { tk_t = token:mod1440_ev_begins }

# The Records: writes every key the logs of the country in scope keep again with today's number, by the old
# dictionary or, for a save older than it, by the order of the names; keeps today's dictionary; and makes
# every portrait, trait, role and medal looked up before stale (global.mod1440_tk_ep).
mod1440_tk_fix = {
	mod1440_tk_now_k = yes
	mod1440_tk_now_v = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tk_k^num > 0 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_date^num
			value = tk_i
			set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_ev_kind^tk_i }
			mod1440_tk_map_k = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_r = token:mod1440_tk_old_line }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^tk_i = tk_r }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_date^num
			value = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^tk_i = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_ev_a^tk_i }
				mod1440_tk_map_v = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^tk_i = 2 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^tk_i = mod1440_ev_p^tk_i }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^tk_i = tk_r }
				}
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_date^num
			value = tk_i
			set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_tr_kind^tk_i }
			mod1440_tk_map_k = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_r = token:mod1440_tk_old_line }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_tr_kind^tk_i = tk_r }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_date^num
			value = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^tk_i = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_tr_a^tk_i }
				mod1440_tk_map_v = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^tk_i = 2 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^tk_i = mod1440_tr_p^tk_i }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^tk_i = tk_r }
				}
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_kp_date^num
			value = tk_i
			set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_kp_kind^tk_i }
			mod1440_tk_map_k = yes
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_r = token:mod1440_tk_old_line }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_kp_kind^tk_i = tk_r }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_kp_date^num
			value = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^tk_i = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_kp_a^tk_i }
				mod1440_tk_map_v = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^tk_i = 2 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_kp_a^tk_i = mod1440_kp_p^tk_i }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_kp_a^tk_i = tk_r }
				}
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_wo_outcome^num
			value = tk_i
			set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_wo_outcome^tk_i }
			mod1440_tk_map_k = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wo_outcome^tk_i = tk_r }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_rec_last_k }
		mod1440_tk_map_k = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { tk_r = -1 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_k = tk_r }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_rec_last_k = token:mod1440_blank }
		}

		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 2 }

		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 2 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_state_received }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 2 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_state_taken }

		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 1 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_volunteers_sent }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 2 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_vp_lost }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 2 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_vp_taken }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 1 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_war_by }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 1 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_war_on }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 1 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_war_with }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_sf = 1 }
		add_to_temp_array = { tk_ss = token:mod1440_ev_we_capitulated }
		set_temp_variable = { tk_bad = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { tk_min = 2000000 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_ev_kind
			value = tk_v
			index = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_kn value = tk_v } } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { tk_bad = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_v < tk_min } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_min = tk_v }
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_tr_kind
			value = tk_v
			index = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_kn value = tk_v } } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { tk_bad = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_v < tk_min } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_min = tk_v }
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_kp_kind
			value = tk_v
			index = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_kn value = tk_v } } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { tk_bad = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_v < tk_min } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_min = tk_v }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { tk_bad > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { tk_hits = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { tk_found = 0 }
			for_loop_effect = {
				start = 0
				end = 52
				value = tk_cand
				set_temp_variable = { tk_base = tk_min }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_base = tk_cand }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_ok = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 0 }
					for_each_loop = {
						array = mod1440_ev_kind
						value = tk_v
						index = tk_i
						break = tk_stop
						set_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_v }
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_base }
						if = {
							limit = { OR = { check_variable = { tk_e < 0 } check_variable = { tk_e > 51 } } }
							set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 1 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { tk_f = tk_sf^tk_e }
							if = {
								limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_fam^tk_i = tk_f } } }
								set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 0 }
								set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 1 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_ok = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 0 }
					for_each_loop = {
						array = mod1440_tr_kind
						value = tk_v
						index = tk_i
						break = tk_stop
						set_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_v }
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_base }
						if = {
							limit = { OR = { check_variable = { tk_e < 0 } check_variable = { tk_e > 51 } } }
							set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 1 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { tk_f = tk_sf^tk_e }
							if = {
								limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_fam^tk_i = tk_f } } }
								set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 0 }
								set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 1 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_ok = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 0 }
					for_each_loop = {
						array = mod1440_kp_kind
						value = tk_v
						index = tk_i
						break = tk_stop
						set_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_v }
						subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_base }
						if = {
							limit = { OR = { check_variable = { tk_e < 0 } check_variable = { tk_e > 51 } } }
							set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 1 }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { tk_f = tk_sf^tk_e }
							if = {
								limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_fam^tk_i = tk_f } } }
								set_temp_variable = { tk_ok = 0 }
								set_temp_variable = { tk_stop = 1 }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { tk_ok = 1 } }
					add_to_temp_variable = { tk_hits = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { tk_found = tk_base }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { tk_hits = 1 } }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_ev_kind
					value = tk_v
					index = tk_i
					set_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_v }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_found }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^tk_i = tk_ss^tk_e }
				}
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_tr_kind
					value = tk_v
					index = tk_i
					set_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_v }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_found }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_kind^tk_i = tk_ss^tk_e }
				}
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_kp_kind
					value = tk_v
					index = tk_i
					set_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_v }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { tk_e = tk_found }
					set_variable = { mod1440_kp_kind^tk_i = tk_ss^tk_e }
				}
			}
			else = {
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_ev_kind
					value = tk_v
					index = tk_i
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_kn value = tk_v } } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^tk_i = token:mod1440_tk_old_line }
					}
				}
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_tr_kind
					value = tk_v
					index = tk_i
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_kn value = tk_v } } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_tr_kind^tk_i = token:mod1440_tk_old_line }
					}
				}
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_kp_kind
					value = tk_v
					index = tk_i
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_kn value = tk_v } } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_kp_kind^tk_i = token:mod1440_tk_old_line }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_date^num
			value = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^tk_i = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_ev_a^tk_i }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_vn value = tk_v } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^tk_i = 2 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^tk_i = mod1440_ev_p^tk_i }
				}
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_date^num
			value = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^tk_i = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_tr_a^tk_i }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_vn value = tk_v } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^tk_i = 2 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^tk_i = mod1440_tr_p^tk_i }
				}
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_kp_date^num
			value = tk_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^tk_i = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { tk_v = mod1440_kp_a^tk_i }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = tk_vn value = tk_v } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^tk_i = 2 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_kp_a^tk_i = mod1440_kp_p^tk_i }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_tk_k
	clear_array = mod1440_tk_kc
	for_each_loop = {
		array = tk_kn
		value = tk_o
		add_to_array = { mod1440_tk_k = tk_o }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = tk_kc
		value = tk_o
		add_to_array = { mod1440_tk_kc = tk_o }
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_tk_v
	clear_array = mod1440_tk_vc
	for_each_loop = {
		array = tk_vn
		value = tk_o
		add_to_array = { mod1440_tk_v = tk_o }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = tk_vc
		value = tk_o
		add_to_array = { mod1440_tk_vc = tk_o }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_tk_ver = 588685 }
	add_to_variable = { global.mod1440_tk_ep = 1 }
	every_state = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_sr_has_by = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { tk_who = mod1440_sr_by }
		set_temp_variable = { tk_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
		PREV = {
			var:tk_who = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
					mod1440_p_officer = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { tk_p = mod1440_p }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_by_p = tk_p }
	}
	log = "MOD1440 records: the numbers of the kept text keys had moved; the logs of [This.GetTag] were written again"
}

# War Diary: copies the lines the chosen filter wants, newest first, from the chosen place on, into the arrays
# the page draws, 200 rows at most: the day on a day's first row, the band of the day, the new lines, a run of
# states folded in All and in a country's lines. All and the lines of one state or country go through both logs
# together; Territory has a log of its own; Marked reads the chronicle; every other filter reads the main log.
# Then the figures of the campaign (sums of the counters) and the newest marked lines.
mod1440_wd_list = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_date
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_kind
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_fam
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_a
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_b
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sa
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sb
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_c
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_sc
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_p
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_n
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_dd
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_fo
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_nw
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_nu
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_k
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_src
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_si
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ap
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_cp
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_st
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ga
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ua
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_gc
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_uc
	set_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_shown = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_day = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_par = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_rn = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_f0 = token:mod1440_ev_state_taken }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_f1 = token:mod1440_ev_state_lost }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_f2 = token:mod1440_ev_state_received }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_f3 = token:mod1440_ev_state_handed }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_cas = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
	set_temp_variable = { wd_fold = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wd_fold = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wd_fold = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_e = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_t = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mg_all
			value = mg_i
			set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_e > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_ed = mod1440_ev_day^mg_e }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_td = mod1440_tr_day^mg_t }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mg_td > mg_ed } }
						set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_e }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { wd_seen = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { wd_prev = wd_seen }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_prev = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wd_seen > mod1440_wd_from } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { wd_fold = 1 } check_variable = { wd_rn > 0 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m = 2 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^mg_m = wd_rk } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_b^mg_m = wd_rb } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_day^mg_m = wd_rd } check_variable = { wd_rs = wd_prev } check_variable = { wd_rn > 1 } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { wd_rn = 1 }
						set_temp_variable = { wd_rs = wd_seen }
						add_to_temp_variable = { wd_shown = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { wd_rn = 3 } }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_r = mod1440_wd_fam^num }
							subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_r = 1 }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_date index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_kind index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_fam index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_a index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_b index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_sa index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_sb index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_c index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_sc index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_p index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_n index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_dd index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_fo index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_nw index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_nu index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_k index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_src index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_si index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_ap index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_cp index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_st index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_ga index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_ua index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_gc index = wd_r }
							remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wd_uc index = wd_r }
							set_variable = { mod1440_wd_fo^wd_rr = 2 }
							set_variable = { mod1440_wd_sc^wd_rr = 0 }
							set_variable = { mod1440_wd_gc^wd_rr = THIS }
							set_variable = { mod1440_wd_uc^wd_rr = 0 }
						}
						else = {
							add_to_variable = { mod1440_wd_fo^wd_rr = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_fam^num < 200 } }
						set_temp_variable = { wd_nl = mod1440_wd_fam^num }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_date = mod1440_ev_date^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_fam = mod1440_ev_fam^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_a = mod1440_ev_a^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sb = mod1440_ev_sb^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_c = mod1440_ev_c^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_sc = mod1440_ev_sc^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_p = mod1440_ev_p^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_n = mod1440_ev_n^mg_m }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sb^mg_m > 0 } }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = mod1440_ev_b^mg_m }
						}
						else = {
							add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_b = THIS }
						}
						set_temp_variable = { wd_d = mod1440_ev_day^mg_m }
						set_temp_variable = { wd_dd = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wd_d = wd_day } } }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_dd = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_day = wd_d }
							if = {
								limit = { check_variable = { wd_par = 0 } }

						add_to_temp_variable = { wd_shown = 1 }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { wd_fold = 1 } check_variable = { wd_rn > 0 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^wd_m = 2 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m = wd_rk } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_b^wd_m = wd_rb } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_day^wd_m = wd_rd } check_variable = { wd_rs = wd_prev } }
							add_to_temp_variable = { wd_rn = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rs = wd_seen }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { wd_fold = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^wd_m = 2 } OR = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m = wd_f0 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m = wd_f1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m = wd_f2 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m = wd_f3 } } }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rn = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rk = mod1440_ev_kind^wd_m }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rb = mod1440_ev_b^wd_m }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rd = mod1440_ev_day^wd_m }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rs = wd_seen }
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rr = wd_nl }
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { wd_rn = 0 }
						}
					}
					else = {
						set_temp_variable = { wd_rn = 0 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_total = wd_seen }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_shown = wd_shown }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_first = mod1440_wd_from }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_wd_first = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_last = mod1440_wd_from }
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_wd_last = wd_shown }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_5 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_6 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_3 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_4 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_5 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_filter = 6 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_frame_6 = 2 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 60
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ct^num < 60 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^1 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^2 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^3 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_wars = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^4 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_peace = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^5 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_cap = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^7 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_annex = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^8 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_subj = ct_sum }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_atwar = mod1440_wr_enemy^num }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^14 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^16 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_st_t = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^15 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^17 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_st_x = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { g_all = mod1440_wd_g_st_t }
	add_to_temp_variable = { g_all = mod1440_wd_g_st_x }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_st_bar = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { g_all > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { g_share = mod1440_wd_g_st_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { g_share = 100 }
		divide_temp_variable = { g_share = g_all }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_st_bar = g_share }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^36 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_vp_t = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^37 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_vp_x = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { g_all = mod1440_wd_g_vp_t }
	add_to_temp_variable = { g_all = mod1440_wd_g_vp_x }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_vp_bar = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { g_all > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { g_share = mod1440_wd_g_vp_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { g_share = 100 }
		divide_temp_variable = { g_share = g_all }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_vp_bar = g_share }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^16 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_cap_t = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^17 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_cap_x = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { g_all = mod1440_wd_g_cap_t }
	add_to_temp_variable = { g_all = mod1440_wd_g_cap_x }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_cap_bar = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { g_all > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { g_share = mod1440_wd_g_cap_t }
		multiply_temp_variable = { g_share = 100 }
		divide_temp_variable = { g_share = g_all }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_g_cap_bar = g_share }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^39 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_trr = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^40 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_trh = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^27 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_comm = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^28 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_prom = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^29 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_lvl = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^30 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_dec = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^41 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_gone = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^21 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^22 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^24 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_n_govs = ct_sum }
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_date
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_kind
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_fam
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_a
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_b
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_sa
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_ch_sb
	set_temp_variable = { wd_c = mod1440_kp_date^num }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 4
		value = wd_ck
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wd_c = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wd_c > -1 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_date = mod1440_kp_date^wd_c }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_kind = mod1440_kp_kind^wd_c }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_fam = mod1440_kp_fam^wd_c }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_a = mod1440_kp_a^wd_c }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_b = mod1440_kp_b^wd_c }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_sa = mod1440_kp_sa^wd_c }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_sb = mod1440_kp_sb^wd_c }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_ch_n = mod1440_wd_ch_date^num }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 4
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_ch_date^num < 4 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_date = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_kind = token:mod1440_blank }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_fam = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_a = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_b = THIS }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_sa = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wd_ch_sb = 0 }
		}
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# War Diary: the first page of the chosen filter.
mod1440_wd_first_page = {
	clear_array = mod1440_wd_back
	set_variable = { mod1440_wd_from = 0 }
	mod1440_wd_list = yes
}

# War Diary: the box at the end of a line. mk_src says which log the row was copied from (1 main, 2 territory,
# 3 the chronicle), mk_si where in it. A line that is not marked is marked in both logs and copied into the
# chronicle, by its day; a marked one loses its mark and leaves the chronicle. Only the mod's own variables.
mod1440_wd_mark = {
	set_temp_variable = { mk_id = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mk_on = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { mk_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mk_src = 1 } check_variable = { mk_si < mod1440_ev_id^num } }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_id = mod1440_ev_id^mk_si }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_on = mod1440_ev_k^mk_si }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_ok = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mk_src = 2 } check_variable = { mk_si < mod1440_tr_id^num } }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_id = mod1440_tr_id^mk_si }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_on = mod1440_tr_k^mk_si }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_ok = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mk_src = 3 } check_variable = { mk_si < mod1440_kp_id^num } }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_id = mod1440_kp_id^mk_si }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_on = mod1440_kp_k^mk_si }
		set_temp_variable = { mk_ok = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mk_ok = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mk_on = 1 } }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_ev_id
				value = mk_v
				index = mk_j
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mk_v = mk_id } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ev_k^mk_j = 0 }
				}
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_tr_id
				value = mk_v
				index = mk_j
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mk_v = mk_id } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_tr_k^mk_j = 0 }
				}
			}
			set_temp_variable = { mk_at = -1 }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_kp_id
				value = mk_v
				index = mk_j
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mk_v = mk_id } }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_at = mk_j }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mk_at > -1 } }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_date index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_day index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_kind index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_fam index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_a index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_b index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sa index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sb index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_c index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sc index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_p index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_x index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_k index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_id index = mk_at }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_kp_n index = mk_at }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_date^num < 300 } check_variable = { mk_src < 3 } }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_ev_id
					value = mk_v
					index = mk_j
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mk_v = mk_id } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_ev_k^mk_j = 1 }
					}
				}
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_tr_id
					value = mk_v
					index = mk_j
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mk_v = mk_id } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_tr_k^mk_j = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mk_src = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_day = mod1440_ev_day^mk_si }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_at = mod1440_kp_day^num }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_brk = 0 }
					for_each_loop = {
						array = mod1440_kp_day
						value = mk_v
						index = mk_j
						break = mk_brk
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mk_v > mk_day } }
							set_temp_variable = { mk_at = mk_j }
							set_temp_variable = { mk_brk = 1 }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mk_brk = 1 } }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_date value = mod1440_ev_date^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_day value = mod1440_ev_day^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_kind value = mod1440_ev_kind^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_fam value = mod1440_ev_fam^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_a value = mod1440_ev_a^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_b value = mod1440_ev_b^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sa value = mod1440_ev_sa^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sb value = mod1440_ev_sb^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_c value = mod1440_ev_c^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sc value = mod1440_ev_sc^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_p value = mod1440_ev_p^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_x value = mod1440_ev_x^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_k value = 1 index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_id value = mod1440_ev_id^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_n value = mod1440_ev_n^mk_si index = mk_at }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_date = mod1440_ev_date^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_day = mod1440_ev_day^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_fam = mod1440_ev_fam^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_a = mod1440_ev_a^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_b = mod1440_ev_b^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_sb = mod1440_ev_sb^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_c = mod1440_ev_c^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_sc = mod1440_ev_sc^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_p = mod1440_ev_p^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_x = mod1440_ev_x^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_k = 1 }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_id = mod1440_ev_id^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_n = mod1440_ev_n^mk_si }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mk_src = 2 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_day = mod1440_tr_day^mk_si }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_at = mod1440_kp_day^num }
					set_temp_variable = { mk_brk = 0 }
					for_each_loop = {
						array = mod1440_kp_day
						value = mk_v
						index = mk_j
						break = mk_brk
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mk_v > mk_day } }
							set_temp_variable = { mk_at = mk_j }
							set_temp_variable = { mk_brk = 1 }
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mk_brk = 1 } }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_date value = mod1440_tr_date^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_day value = mod1440_tr_day^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_kind value = mod1440_tr_kind^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_fam value = mod1440_tr_fam^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_a value = mod1440_tr_a^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_b value = mod1440_tr_b^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sa value = mod1440_tr_sa^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sb value = mod1440_tr_sb^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_c value = mod1440_tr_c^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_sc value = mod1440_tr_sc^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_p value = mod1440_tr_p^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_x value = mod1440_tr_x^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_k value = 1 index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_id value = mod1440_tr_id^mk_si index = mk_at }
						add_to_array = { array = mod1440_kp_n value = mod1440_tr_n^mk_si index = mk_at }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_date = mod1440_tr_date^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_day = mod1440_tr_day^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_fam = mod1440_tr_fam^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_a = mod1440_tr_a^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_b = mod1440_tr_b^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_sb = mod1440_tr_sb^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_c = mod1440_tr_c^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_sc = mod1440_tr_sc^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_p = mod1440_tr_p^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_x = mod1440_tr_x^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_k = 1 }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_id = mod1440_tr_id^mk_si }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_kp_n = mod1440_tr_n^mk_si }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		mod1440_wd_list = yes
	}
}

# Characters: what a variable can hold of the officer in scope, in of_me. His number, or for a leader without
# one his place; 0 while that is not known.
mod1440_of_me = {
	set_temp_variable = { of_me = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { of_me = -21474.83648 } }
		set_temp_variable = { of_me = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_me = mod1440_ch_at }
		}
	}
}

# Characters: writes on the character at the place ch_v that he stands there, so that a later day can tell
# whether the place is still his. For the scope of a country: a place nobody stands on leaves the scope
# where it is, and what THIS is there tells that apart.
mod1440_ch_mark = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ch_v > 5368 } }
		var:ch_v = {
			set_temp_variable = { ch_t = THIS }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { ch_t = ch_v } check_variable = { ch_t < 0 } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = ch_v }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ch_v > global.mod1440_ch_top } }
					set_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top = ch_v }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Characters: for the country in scope, gives every general and admiral without a number his place, and
# looks whether the places kept so far still lead to their characters. If not, everybody is found again
# (rf_old, rf_new: where each one was and is) and the lists of every country with a record are put right.
mod1440_of_refs = {
	mod1440_ch_adopt = yes
	set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rf_need = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rf_found = 0 }
	clear_temp_array = rf_old
	clear_temp_array = rf_new
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_r = global.mod1440_ch_top }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 0 }
		var:rf_r = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_r } }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_ok = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 1 }
		}
	}
	every_army_leader = {
		set_temp_variable = { rf_me = THIS }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_me = -21474.83648 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_r = mod1440_ch_at }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 0 }
				PREV = {
					var:rf_r = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_r } }
							set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { rf_ok = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_at } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ch_probe = 1 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { rf_need = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	every_navy_leader = {
		set_temp_variable = { rf_me = THIS }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_me = -21474.83648 } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_r = mod1440_ch_at }
				set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 0 }
				PREV = {
					var:rf_r = {
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_r } }
							set_temp_variable = { rf_ok = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { rf_ok = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { rf_stale = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_at } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_ch_probe = 1 }
					add_to_temp_variable = { rf_need = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { rf_stale = 1 } check_variable = { rf_found < rf_need } } }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_c = 5368.70912 }
		set_temp_variable = { rf_top = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 120
			value = rf_block
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { rf_stale = 1 } check_variable = { rf_found < rf_need } } }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 0
					end = 1000
					value = rf_i
					var:rf_c = {
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_probe }
							clear_variable = mod1440_ch_probe
							set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_c }
							add_to_temp_variable = { rf_found = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { rf_top = rf_c }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at > 0 } }
							if = {
								limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_c } } }
								add_to_temp_array = { rf_old = mod1440_ch_at }
								add_to_temp_array = { rf_new = rf_c }
								set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rf_c }
							}
							set_temp_variable = { rf_top = rf_c }
						}
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { rf_c = 0.00001 }
				}
			}
		}
		every_army_leader = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_probe }
				clear_variable = mod1440_ch_probe
				set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = -1 }
			}
		}
		every_navy_leader = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = mod1440_ch_probe }
				clear_variable = mod1440_ch_probe
				set_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = -1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rf_stale = 1 } }
			set_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top = rf_top }
			every_country = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } }
				mod1440_ch_remap = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rf_top > global.mod1440_ch_top } }
				set_variable = { global.mod1440_ch_top = rf_top }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Characters: where the character of the place rm_v stands now, in rm_to: looked up in rf_old and rf_new, and 0
# when nobody at that place says it is his (the character is gone, or was never marked).
mod1440_ch_place = {
	set_temp_variable = { rm_to = rm_v }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rm_v > 5368 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_brk = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = rf_old
			index = rm_k
			value = rm_o
			break = rm_brk
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_o = rm_v } }
				set_temp_variable = { rm_to = rf_new^rm_k }
				set_temp_variable = { rm_brk = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { rm_ok = 0 }
		var:rm_to = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_at = rm_to } }
				set_temp_variable = { rm_ok = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { rm_ok = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_to = 0 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { rm_lost = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Characters: puts right every place the country in scope keeps, after the game's list of characters has
# changed: the people on the lines of both logs, the list of officers, the chosen officer, the offices, the
# army chosen on Army Readiness.
mod1440_ch_remap = {
	set_temp_variable = { rm_lost = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_ev_a^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_ev_a^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_ev_c^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_ev_c^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_c^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_tr_a^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_tr_a^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_tr_c^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_tr_c^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_tr_c^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_kp_a^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_kp_a^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_kp_a^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_kp_c^num
		value = rm_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_kp_c^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_place = yes
			set_variable = { mod1440_kp_c^rm_i = rm_to }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { rm_to = 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_kp_sc^rm_i = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_of_known^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_of_known^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_known^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	clear_temp_array = rm_keep
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_known
		value = rm_v
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rm_v = 0 } } }
			add_to_temp_array = { rm_keep = rm_v }
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_of_known
	for_each_loop = {
		array = rm_keep
		value = rm_v
		add_to_array = { mod1440_of_known = rm_v }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_of_sel }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_sel = rm_to }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_sel = 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 0 }
			clear_array = mod1440_of_c_ul
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_ar_sel }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_ar_sel = rm_to }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ar_sel = 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ar_has_sel = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { rm_lost = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_leader }
	mod1440_ch_place = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = rm_to }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_0 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0 = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_1 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1 = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_2 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2 = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_of_3 }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3 = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_gv_adv^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_adv^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_gv_hc^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_hc^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_hc^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_gv_rul^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_gv_rul^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rm_lost > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 0 }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wr_lu0^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wr_lu0^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_lu0^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wr_lt0^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wr_lt0^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_lt0^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wr_lt1^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wr_lt1^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_lt1^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wo_lu0^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wo_lu0^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wo_lu0^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wo_lu1^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wo_lu1^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wo_lu1^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wo_lt0^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wo_lt0^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wo_lt0^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wo_lt1^num
		value = rm_i
		set_temp_variable = { rm_v = mod1440_wo_lt1^rm_i }
		mod1440_ch_place = yes
		set_variable = { mod1440_wo_lt1^rm_i = rm_to }
	}
}

# Characters: once for a country, marks everybody whose place its lists hold already (a game saved by an
# earlier build of the mod).
mod1440_ch_adopt = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ch_adopted = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ch_adopted = 1 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_a^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_ev_a^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_ev_c^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_ev_c^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_a^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_tr_a^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_tr_c^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_tr_c^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_kp_a^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_sa^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_kp_a^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_kp_c^num
			value = rm_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_kp_sc^rm_i = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_kp_c^rm_i }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_of_known^num
			value = rm_i
			set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_of_known^rm_i }
			mod1440_ch_mark = yes
		}
		mod1440_gv_marks = yes
	}
}

# Characters: marks the holders of the offices the Government page keeps.
mod1440_gv_marks = {
	set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_leader }
	mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_0_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_0 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_1_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_1 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_2_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_2 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_of_3_has = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = mod1440_gv_of_3 }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_gv_adv
		value = ch_v
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_gv_hc
		value = ch_v
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_gv_rul
		value = ch_v
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
	}
}

				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:meticulous }
			}

				limit = { has_trait = walloon }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:walloon }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = retraining }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:retraining }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = jumping_general }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:jumping_general }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = skeletons_blessing }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:skeletons_blessing }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = attentive_surgeon }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:attentive_surgeon }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr^num < num_traits } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = EGY_aristocrat }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:EGY_aristocrat }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = AFG_barakzai_royalist }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:AFG_barakzai_royalist }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = AUS_nazi_loyalties }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:AUS_nazi_loyalties }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = ARM_anti_communist_sympathizer }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:ARM_anti_communist_sympathizer }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = MEN_fascist_sympathies }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:MEN_fascist_sympathies }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_marshal_master_exploder }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_marshal_master_exploder }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_vibrates }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_vibrates }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_packed_lunch }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_packed_lunch }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_saw_a_squirrel }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_saw_a_squirrel }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_knows_what_you_did }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_knows_what_you_did }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_force_user }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_force_user }

			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_is_a_lemur }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_is_a_lemur }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_army_personal_space }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_personal_space }

				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_army_free_coffee }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_navy_ocean_haiku }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_navy_ocean_haiku }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_navy_hates_water }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_navy_hates_water }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr^num < num_traits } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_navy_rubber_duck }

				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_navy_can_swim }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_i = mod1440_of_tr^num }
	if = {
		limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr^num < num_traits } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = JAP_samurai_lineage }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:JAP_samurai_lineage }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = trait_SOV_monarchist_sympathizer }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:trait_SOV_monarchist_sympathizer }

				limit = { has_trait = SIA_under_investigation }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:SIA_under_investigation }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = EGY_brotherhood_sympathiser }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:EGY_brotherhood_sympathiser }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_generic_is_breathing }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_generic_is_breathing }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr^num < num_traits } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = promoted_from_the_ranks }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:promoted_from_the_ranks }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = JAP_samurai_lineage }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:JAP_samurai_lineage }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = trait_SOV_monarchist_sympathizer }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:trait_SOV_monarchist_sympathizer }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = motivated }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:motivated }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = INS_secret_commander }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:INS_secret_commander }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = SIA_under_investigation }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:SIA_under_investigation }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = exiled_leader }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:exiled_leader }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = EGY_brotherhood_sympathiser }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:EGY_brotherhood_sympathiser }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = too_young_too_simple }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:too_young_too_simple }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = sometimes_naive }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:sometimes_naive }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = i_am_angry }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:i_am_angry }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = black_rimmed_glasses }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:black_rimmed_glasses }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = experienced_100_battles }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:experienced_100_battles }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_trait = r56w_trait_generic_is_breathing }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:r56w_trait_generic_is_breathing }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_k = mod1440_of_tr^num }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_n = num_traits }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v = 646776 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
	set_temp_variable = { tr_shown = mod1440_of_tr_i }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = tr_shown max = 6 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_plus = num_traits }
	subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_plus = tr_shown }
	clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_of_tr_plus min = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 6
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr^num < 6 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_tr = token:unknown }
		}
	}
}

# Officers: the medals at half size in his row: the strips and frames of his first 3 decorations, padded.
mod1440_of_rack = {
	clear_array = mod1440_of_rm
	clear_array = mod1440_of_rf
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_dec_set
		value = md_v
		index = md_ix
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { md_ix < 3 } }
			set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_aus }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_aus }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_chl }

				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_communism }

			else_if = {

				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_cze }

			}
			else_if = {

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 10 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_fin }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 11 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_fra }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 12 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_ger }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 13 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_hun }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 14 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_ita }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 15 } }

				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 16 } }

			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 17 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_nor }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 18 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_sov }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 19 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_swe }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 20 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_usa }
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rm = md_strip }
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_dec_frame
		value = md_v
		index = md_ix
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { md_ix < 3 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rf = md_v }
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 3
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_rm^num < 3 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rm = token:GFX_1440p_medal_aus }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rf = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_rm_n = mod1440_of_dec^num }
}
