# Officers: marks every officer who serves today with the day, and adds an officer the record does not know
# yet to its list. A retired officer keeps his place in that list (X34). How many serve: the count of the tab.
mod1440_of_seen = {
	mod1440_of_refs = yes
	set_temp_variable = { of_had = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_listed = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { of_had = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { of_new = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { of_serving = 0 }
	every_army_leader = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			mod1440_p_officer = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { of_serving = 1 }
		mod1440_of_me = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_known = of_me }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_had = 1 } NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_of_since_day } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since = global.date }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_temp_variable = { of_new = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { of_new < 9 } }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_commissioned }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 27 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
					PREV = {
						mod1440_ev_add = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v = 646776 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_n = num_traits } } } }
			mod1440_of_traits = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_md_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } }
			mod1440_of_medals_again = yes
		}
	}
	every_navy_leader = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			mod1440_p_officer = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { of_serving = 1 }
		mod1440_of_me = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 } } NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_known = 1 }
			add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_known = of_me }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_had = 1 } NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_of_since_day } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since = global.date }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_temp_variable = { of_new = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { of_new < 9 } }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_commissioned }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 27 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
					PREV = {
						mod1440_ev_add = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v = 646776 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_n = num_traits } } } }
			mod1440_of_traits = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_md_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } }
			mod1440_of_medals_again = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_listed = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_serving = of_serving }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { of_new > 8 } }
		set_temp_variable = { of_more = of_new }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { of_more = 8 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_commissioned_more }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 38 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = of_more }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_ct^27 = of_more }
	}
}

# Officers (E1 review, 2026-10-22): once a day after mod1440_of_seen, a line for an officer the record knows who
# was not met today (Left the service) or who is held by an enemy (Captured:). The marks mod1440_of_out and
# mod1440_of_held on him keep each to one line; met again, free again, the mark clears. The first run takes
# those already gone without a line.
mod1440_of_gone = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_gone_v = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_gone_v = 1 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_known
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_out = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } is_general_captured = yes }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_held = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_known
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_out = 1 } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_of_out = 1 }
					mod1440_of_me = yes
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } is_general_captured = yes NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_held = 1 } } }
							set_variable = { mod1440_of_held = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_officer_captured }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 42 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
							PREV = {
								mod1440_ev_add = yes
							}
						}
						else = {
							set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_officer_gone }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 41 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
							PREV = {
								mod1440_ev_add = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { mod1440_of_out = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } is_general_captured = yes }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_held = 1 } } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_of_held = 1 }
						mod1440_of_me = yes
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_officer_captured }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 42 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_a = of_me }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
							set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
							PREV = {
								mod1440_ev_add = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { mod1440_of_held = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Officers: makes the list of the page again: who the filter wants, in the order of the chosen column,
# every second row marked for its stripe.
mod1440_of_list = {
	mod1440_of_seen = yes
	clear_array = mod1440_of_rows
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_known
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_ul = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			mod1440_p_officer = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v = 646776 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
			mod1440_of_traits = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_md_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } }
			mod1440_of_medals_again = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_rm_n = mod1440_of_dec^num } } }
			mod1440_of_rack = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_rm^num < 3 } }
			mod1440_of_rack = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 5 } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 5 } } check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 1 } is_navy_leader = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 2 } NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 3 } check_variable = { num_units < 1 } check_variable = { num_ships < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_show = 4 } check_variable = { mod1440_of_dec^num < 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_keep = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_keep = 1 } }
			mod1440_of_me = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
				add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_of_rows = of_me }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_sort_by > 0 } }
		clear_array = mod1440_of_keys
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_rows
			set_temp_variable = { of_key = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = skill_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = attack_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 3 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = defense_level }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 4 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = planning_level }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = maneuvering_level }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 5 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = logistics_level }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = coordination_level }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 6 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_traits }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 7 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_units }
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { of_key = num_ships }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 8 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_won }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_lost }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_sort_by = 10 } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_key = mod1440_of_dec^num }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROOT.mod1440_of_up = 1 } }
				multiply_temp_variable = { of_key = -1 }
			}
			add_to_array = { ROOT.mod1440_of_keys = of_key }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_sorted
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_of_rows^num
			value = of_step
			find_highest_in_array = {
				array = mod1440_of_keys
				value = of_high
				index = of_at
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_sorted = mod1440_of_rows^of_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_of_keys^of_at = -2000000 }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_rows
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_sorted
			value = of_copy
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_rows = of_copy }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { of_par = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = mod1440_of_rows
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_odd = of_par }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_par = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { of_par = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { of_par = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_0 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_4 = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_5 = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_0 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_1 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 2 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_2 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 3 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_3 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 4 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_4 = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_show = 5 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_frame_5 = 2 }
	}
	mod1440_md_list = yes
	mod1440_of_card = yes
}

# Officers: copies the chosen officer's values, traits, record, decorations and diary lines to the country,
# where his file reads them. His own values are read in his scope (X33).
mod1440_of_card = {
	clear_array = mod1440_of_c_ul
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		mod1440_ev_grow = yes
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_key
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_date
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_set
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_frame
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_dec_strip
		clear_array = mod1440_of_c_tr
		set_temp_variable = { of_ul = 0 }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_skill = skill_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_atk = attack_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_def = defense_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_c3 = planning_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_c4 = logistics_level }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 2 }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_cmd = num_units }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_bat = num_battalions }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_fight = num_units_in_combat }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_arm = num_armored }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_plan = avg_unit_planning_ratio }
			if = {
				limit = { is_field_marshal = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_rank = 3 }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_cmd = num_ships }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_c3 = maneuvering_level }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_c4 = coordination_level }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_k1 = num_ships_with_type@carrier }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_k2 = num_ships_with_type@capital }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_k3 = num_ships_with_type@screen }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_k4 = num_ships_with_type@submarine }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_status = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { check_variable = { num_units > 0 } check_variable = { num_ships > 0 } } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_status = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { is_leading_army_group = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_status = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_navy_leader = yes } is_general_captured = yes }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_status = 3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_seen_day < global.num_days } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_status = 4 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v = 646776 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_v_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_tr_n = num_traits } } } }
				mod1440_of_traits = yes
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_traits = num_traits }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_max = num_max_traits }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr_i = mod1440_of_tr_i }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr_k = mod1440_of_tr_k }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr_other = num_traits }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr_other = mod1440_of_tr_k }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr_over = mod1440_of_tr_k }
			subtract_from_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr_over = 6 }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_tr
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_tr = of_v }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_won = mod1440_of_won }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_lost = mod1440_of_lost }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_states = mod1440_of_states }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_vps = mod1440_of_vps }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_vpl = mod1440_of_vpl }
			if = {
				limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { of_ul = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
					mod1440_p_officer = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
				}
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_p = mod1440_p }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_since = mod1440_of_since }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_since = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_since_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_since = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_prom = mod1440_of_prom }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_prom = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_prom_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_prom = 1 }
			}
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_lvl = mod1440_of_lvl }
			set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_lvl = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_lvl_day > 0 } }
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_has_lvl = 1 }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_key
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_key = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_date
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_date = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_set
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_set = of_v }
			}
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_of_dec_frame
				value = of_v
				add_to_array = { PREV.mod1440_of_c_dec_frame = of_v }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_ul = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_ul = mod1440_of_sel }
		}
		clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_of_c_tr_other min = 0 }
		clamp_variable = { var = mod1440_of_c_tr_over min = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_n = mod1440_of_c_dec_key^num }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_of_c_dec_set
			value = md_v
			index = md_ix
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { md_ix < 9 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_aus }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_aus }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_chl }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 2 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_communism }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 3 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_cze }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 4 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_default }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 5 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_democratic }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 6 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_den }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 7 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_eng }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 8 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_eth }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 9 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_fascism }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 10 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_fin }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 11 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_fra }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 12 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_ger }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 13 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_hun }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 14 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_ita }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 15 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_jap }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 16 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_men }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 17 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_nor }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 18 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_sov }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 19 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_swe }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { md_v = 20 } }
					set_temp_variable = { md_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_usa }
				}
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_strip = md_strip }
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 9
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_key^num < 9 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_key = token:mod1440_blank }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_set = -1 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_frame = 1 }
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 9
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_dec_strip^num < 9 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_dec_strip = token:GFX_1440p_medal_aus }
			}
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 6
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_tr^num < 6 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_c_tr = token:unknown }
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_md_id
			value = md_v
			index = md_i
			set_temp_variable = { md_h = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { md_d = 0 }
			var:mod1440_of_sel = {
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_of_dec
					value = md_w
					index = md_j
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { md_w = md_v } }
						set_temp_variable = { md_h = 1 }
						set_temp_variable = { md_d = mod1440_of_dec_date^md_j }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_md_has^md_i = md_h }
			set_variable = { mod1440_md_date^md_i = md_d }
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_date
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_kind
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_a
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_sa
		clear_array = mod1440_of_ln_fam
		set_temp_variable = { mg_e = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_t = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_ev_date^num }
		add_to_temp_variable = { mg_all = mod1440_tr_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mg_all
			value = mg_i
			set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_e > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_ed = mod1440_ev_day^mg_e }
					set_temp_variable = { mg_td = mod1440_tr_day^mg_t }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mg_td > mg_ed } }
						set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_t > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_log = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_e }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_e = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 11 } OR = { AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_a^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sc^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_ev_c^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = mod1440_ev_date^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = mod1440_ev_kind^mg_m }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_fam = mod1440_ev_fam^mg_m }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m > 1 } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = mod1440_ev_a^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = mod1440_ev_sa^mg_m }
					}
					else = {
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = 0 }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = 0 }
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mg_log = 2 } }
				set_temp_variable = { mg_m = mg_t }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { mg_t = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_x^mg_m = 1 } } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 11 } OR = { AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_tr_a^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } AND = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sc^mg_m = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_tr_c^mg_m = mod1440_of_sel } } } }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = mod1440_tr_date^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = mod1440_tr_kind^mg_m }
						add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_fam = mod1440_tr_fam^mg_m }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m > 1 } }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = mod1440_tr_a^mg_m }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = mod1440_tr_sa^mg_m }
						}
						else = {
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = 0 }
							add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = 0 }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_n = mod1440_of_ln_date^num }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 11
			value = pad_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_ln_date^num < 11 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_date = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_kind = token:mod1440_blank }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_a = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_sa = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_ln_fam = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_awarding = 0 }
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# Officers: gives the chosen officer the medal of slot md_k, once. A record of the mod: arrays on the
# officer. The War Diary gets a line.
mod1440_md_award = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } check_variable = { md_k < mod1440_md_count } }
		set_temp_variable = { md_id = mod1440_md_id^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_key = mod1440_md_key^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_set = mod1440_md_set^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_frame = mod1440_md_frame^md_k }
		set_temp_variable = { md_done = 0 }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec value = md_id } } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec = md_id }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_key = md_key }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_date = global.date }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_set = md_set }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_of_dec_frame = md_frame }
				set_temp_variable = { md_done = 1 }
				mod1440_of_rack = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { md_done = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_decorated }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 30 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = mod1440_of_sel }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		mod1440_of_card = yes
	}
}
mod1440_md_takeback = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_has_sel = 1 } }
		var:mod1440_of_sel = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_dec^num > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { md_n = mod1440_of_dec^num }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { md_n = 1 }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_key index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_date index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_set index = md_n }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_of_dec_frame index = md_n }
				mod1440_of_rack = yes
			}
		}
		mod1440_of_card = yes
	}
}


# Government: compares who holds each office with yesterday's copy. A new name gets today's date, a line
# in the War Diary, and his portrait and role; a name that is gone a line. The first run only takes the copy.
# Then the heads of government since the record began, the laws in force and their pictures, the length
# of the parties' bars, the leader's portrait, the seats the page shows and the figures of the record.
mod1440_gv_daily = {
	set_temp_variable = { gv_stale = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv_ver = 453881 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
		set_temp_variable = { gv_stale = 1 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_gv_rul
			value = gv_v
			index = gv_i
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { gv_i < mod1440_gv_rul_p^num } NOT = { check_variable = { gv_v = 0 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				var:gv_v = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
				set_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul_p^gv_i = p_tok }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = country_leader } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader = country_leader }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_since = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_leader_old = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 24 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = country_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { p_face = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader } } } }
		set_temp_variable = { p_ld = country_leader }
		var:p_ld = {
			mod1440_p_leader = yes
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p = p_tok }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 568382 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { p_face = mod1440_ld_p }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_p = p_face }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^num < 1 } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^0 = country_leader } } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul_to^0 = global.date }
			set_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul_end^0 = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { gv_g = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_government = fascism }
			set_temp_variable = { gv_g = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_government = democratic }
			set_temp_variable = { gv_g = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_government = communism }
			set_temp_variable = { gv_g = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_government = neutrality }
			set_temp_variable = { gv_g = 4 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { gv_cl = country_leader }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul value = gv_cl index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul_from value = mod1440_gv_leader_since index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul_old value = mod1440_gv_leader_old index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul_to value = 0 index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul_end value = 0 index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul_p value = mod1440_gv_p index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_gv_rul_g value = gv_g index = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^num > 100 } }
			set_temp_variable = { gv_last = mod1440_gv_rul^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { gv_last = 1 }
