			add_to_array = { mod1440_ct = 0 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^23 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_elections = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^21 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^22 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_changes = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^24 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_heads = ct_sum }
	set_temp_variable = { ct_sum = 0 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { ct_sum = mod1440_ct^25 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_n_appointed = ct_sum }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_begun = 1 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv_ver = 453881 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_gv_adv_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
	mod1440_gv_marks = yes
}

# Wars: a row for the enemy in wr_c, from today (wr_old = 1: the war ran when the record began; wr_how: 1 we
# declared, 2 they declared, 3 it joined, 0 not known). It joins the war of an open row whose enemy fights on its
# side, against whom the country has the same role; it keeps the readings of the first day and both heads of
# government.
mod1440_wr_open = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_me = THIS }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_c = wr_me } }
		log = "MOD1440 records: no war row for [This.GetTag] against itself"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy value = wr_c } } NOT = { check_variable = { wr_c = wr_me } } }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_next = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_g = mod1440_wr_next }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_r = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_offensive_war_with = var:wr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_r = 1 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_b = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_wr_enemy
			value = wr_v
			index = wr_i
			break = wr_b
			set_temp_variable = { wr_r2 = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_offensive_war_with = var:wr_v }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_r2 = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wr_r2 = wr_r } var:wr_c = { has_war_together_with = var:wr_v } }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_g = mod1440_wr_grp^wr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_b = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_k0 = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_t0 = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_c = { exists = yes } OR = { check_variable = { wr_old = 0 } is_in_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy value = wr_c } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = THIS }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = wr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = 0 }
			mod1440_wr_kread = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_k0 = kr }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = wr_c }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = 0 }
			mod1440_wr_kread = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_t0 = kr }
		}
		mod1440_wr_hog = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wr_lu = hg_l }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_pu = hg_p }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_gu = hg_g }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_lt = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_pt = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_gt = 0 }
		var:wr_c = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = yes }
				mod1440_wr_hog = yes
				set_temp_variable = { wr_lt = hg_l }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_pt = hg_p }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_gt = hg_g }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = wr_lu }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = wr_lt }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_enemy = wr_c }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_since = global.date }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_day0 = global.num_days }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_cas0 = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_taken = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lost = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_days = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_cas = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_capd = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_old = wr_old }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_surr = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpt = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpl = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_id = mod1440_wr_next }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ecas0 = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ecas = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_grp = wr_g }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_how = wr_how }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kday = global.num_days }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kus0 = wr_k0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kthem0 = wr_t0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kus = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kthem = 0 }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lu0 = wr_lu }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_pu0 = wr_pu }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_gu0 = wr_gu }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lt0 = wr_lt }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_pt0 = wr_pt }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_gt0 = wr_gt }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lt1 = wr_lt }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_pt1 = wr_pt }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_gt1 = wr_gt }
	}
	mod1440_wr_count_wars = yes
}
mod1440_wr_grow = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpt^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpt^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpt = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpl^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_vpl = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_vpt^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_vpt^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_vpt = 0 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_vpl^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_vpl = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_id^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_id^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_i = mod1440_wr_id^num }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_id^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
					add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_next = 1 }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_id = mod1440_wr_next }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_ecas0^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_c = mod1440_wr_enemy^gr_i }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_e = 0 }
					var:gr_c = {
						set_temp_variable = { gr_e = casualties }
					}
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ecas0 = gr_e }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_ecas^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ecas = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_id^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_id^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_i = mod1440_wo_id^num }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_id^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
					add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_next = 1 }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_id = mod1440_wr_next }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_day0^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_day0 = -1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_ecas^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_ecas = 0 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_oc^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_o = mod1440_wo_outcome^gr_i }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_oc = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_t = token:mod1440_wr_out_capitulated }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_o = gr_t } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_oc = 2 }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { gr_t = token:mod1440_wr_out_subject }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_o = gr_t } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_oc = 3 }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { gr_t = token:mod1440_wr_out_annexed }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_o = gr_t } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_oc = 4 }
					}
					set_temp_variable = { gr_t = token:mod1440_wr_out_gone }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_o = gr_t } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_oc = 5 }
					}
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_oc = gr_oc }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_fr^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_fr = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_oc^gr_i = 1 } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_fr = 3 }
					}
					add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_fr = gr_fr }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_grp^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_grp^num < mod1440_wr_enemy^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_i = mod1440_wr_grp^num }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_c = mod1440_wr_enemy^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_g = mod1440_wr_id^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_r = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { has_offensive_war_with = var:gr_c }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_r = 1 }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 0 }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 0
					end = gr_i
					value = gr_k
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_b = 0 } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_v = mod1440_wr_enemy^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_r2 = 0 }
						if = {
							limit = { has_offensive_war_with = var:gr_v }
							set_temp_variable = { gr_r2 = 1 }
						}
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { gr_r2 = gr_r } var:gr_c = { has_war_together_with = var:gr_v } }
							set_temp_variable = { gr_g = mod1440_wr_grp^gr_k }
							set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { gr_k0 = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_t0 = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_kd = mod1440_wr_day0^gr_i }
				if = {
					limit = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy value = gr_c } var:gr_c = { exists = yes } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = THIS }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = gr_c }
					set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = 0 }
					mod1440_wr_kread = yes
					set_temp_variable = { gr_k0 = kr }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = gr_c }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = THIS }
					set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = 0 }
					mod1440_wr_kread = yes
					set_temp_variable = { gr_t0 = kr }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_kd = global.num_days }
				}
				mod1440_wr_hog = yes
				set_temp_variable = { gr_u_l = hg_l }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_u_p = hg_p }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_u_g = hg_g }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_s = mod1440_wr_since^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_hit = 0 }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_gv_rul
					value = gr_v
					index = gr_k
					break = gr_hit
					set_temp_variable = { gr_f = mod1440_gv_rul_from^gr_k }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { gr_f > gr_s } } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_u_l = gr_v }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_u_p = mod1440_gv_rul_p^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_u_g = mod1440_gv_rul_g^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_hit = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_hit = 0 } check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^num > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_k = mod1440_gv_rul^num }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { gr_k = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_u_l = mod1440_gv_rul^gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_u_p = mod1440_gv_rul_p^gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_u_g = mod1440_gv_rul_g^gr_k }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_u_p = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_u_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { gr_lt = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_pt = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_gt = 0 }
				var:gr_c = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						mod1440_wr_hog = yes
						set_temp_variable = { gr_lt = hg_l }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_pt = hg_p }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_gt = hg_g }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = gr_u_l }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = gr_lt }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_grp = gr_g }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_how = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kday = gr_kd }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kus0 = gr_k0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kthem0 = gr_t0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kus = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_kthem = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lu0 = gr_u_l }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_pu0 = gr_u_p }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_gu0 = gr_u_g }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lt0 = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_pt0 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_gt0 = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_lt1 = gr_lt }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_pt1 = gr_pt }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_gt1 = gr_gt }
			}
		}
		log = "MOD1440 records: the rows of wr were given their wars, casualties and leaders (E4 round 2)"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_grp^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = 200
			value = gr_n
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_grp^num < mod1440_wo_enemy^num } }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_i = mod1440_wo_grp^num }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_c = mod1440_wo_enemy^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_u = mod1440_wo_until^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_g = mod1440_wo_id^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 0 }
				for_loop_effect = {
					start = 0
					end = gr_i
					value = gr_k
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_b = 0 } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_v = mod1440_wo_until^gr_k }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { gr_v = gr_u } }
							set_temp_variable = { gr_g = mod1440_wo_grp^gr_k }
							set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { gr_ku = -1 }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_kt = -1 }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_seen = 0 }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_wo_enemy
					value = gr_v
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_v = gr_c } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { gr_seen = 1 }
					}
				}
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_wr_enemy
					value = gr_v
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { gr_v = gr_c } }
						add_to_temp_variable = { gr_seen = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_seen = 1 } var:gr_c = { exists = yes } NOT = { has_war_with = var:gr_c } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = THIS }
					set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = gr_c }
					set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = 0 }
					mod1440_wr_kread = yes
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { kr > 0 } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_ku = kr }
						set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = gr_c }
						set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = THIS }
						set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = 0 }
						mod1440_wr_kread = yes
						set_temp_variable = { gr_kt = kr }
					}
				}
				mod1440_wr_hog = yes
				set_temp_variable = { gr_a_l = hg_l }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_a_p = hg_p }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_a_g = hg_g }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_s = mod1440_wo_since^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_hit = 0 }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_gv_rul
					value = gr_v
					index = gr_k
					break = gr_hit
					set_temp_variable = { gr_f = mod1440_gv_rul_from^gr_k }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { gr_f > gr_s } } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_a_l = gr_v }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_a_p = mod1440_gv_rul_p^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_a_g = mod1440_gv_rul_g^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_hit = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_hit = 0 } check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^num > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_k = mod1440_gv_rul^num }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { gr_k = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_a_l = mod1440_gv_rul^gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_a_p = mod1440_gv_rul_p^gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_a_g = mod1440_gv_rul_g^gr_k }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_a_p = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_a_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				}
				mod1440_wr_hog = yes
				set_temp_variable = { gr_z_l = hg_l }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_z_p = hg_p }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_z_g = hg_g }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_s = mod1440_wo_until^gr_i }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_hit = 0 }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_gv_rul
					value = gr_v
					index = gr_k
					break = gr_hit
					set_temp_variable = { gr_f = mod1440_gv_rul_from^gr_k }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { gr_f > gr_s } } }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_z_l = gr_v }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_z_p = mod1440_gv_rul_p^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_z_g = mod1440_gv_rul_g^gr_k }
						set_temp_variable = { gr_hit = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_hit = 0 } check_variable = { mod1440_gv_rul^num > 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_k = mod1440_gv_rul^num }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { gr_k = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_z_l = mod1440_gv_rul^gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_z_p = mod1440_gv_rul_p^gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_z_g = mod1440_gv_rul_g^gr_k }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_z_p = 0 } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_z_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = gr_a_l }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = gr_z_l }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_grp = gr_g }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_how = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_kday = -1 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_kus = gr_ku }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_kthem = gr_kt }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_lu0 = gr_a_l }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_pu0 = gr_a_p }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_gu0 = gr_a_g }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_lu1 = gr_z_l }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_pu1 = gr_z_p }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_gu1 = gr_z_g }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_lt0 = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_pt0 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_gt0 = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_lt1 = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_pt1 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wo_gt1 = 0 }
			}
		}
		log = "MOD1440 records: the rows of wo were given their wars, casualties and leaders (E4 round 2)"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_fix1 = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_fix1 = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { gr_me = THIS }
		set_temp_variable = { gr_go = 1 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { gr_go = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { gr_go = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { gr_x = -1 }
			set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 0 }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_wr_enemy
				value = gr_v
				index = gr_k
				break = gr_b
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_v = gr_me } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_x = gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { gr_x > -1 } }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_since index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_day0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_taken index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lost index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_days index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_capd index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_old index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_surr index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_vpt index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_vpl index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_id index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_ecas0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_ecas index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_grp index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_how index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kday index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kus0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kthem0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kus index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kthem index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lu0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_pu0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_gu0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lt0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_pt0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_gt0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lt1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_pt1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_gt1 index = gr_x }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_go = 1 }
				log = "MOD1440 records: a row of wr against the country itself was dropped (E4 fix round 1)"
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { gr_go = 1 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { gr_go = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { gr_go = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { gr_x = -1 }
			set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 0 }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_wo_enemy
				value = gr_v
				index = gr_k
				break = gr_b
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { gr_v = gr_me } }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_x = gr_k }
					set_temp_variable = { gr_b = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { gr_x > -1 } }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpt index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpl index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_id index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_day0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_ecas index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_oc index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_fr index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_grp index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_how index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kday index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kus index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kthem index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lu0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pu0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gu0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lu1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pu1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gu1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lt0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pt0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gt0 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lt1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pt1 index = gr_x }
				remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gt1 index = gr_x }
				set_temp_variable = { gr_go = 1 }
				log = "MOD1440 records: a row of wo against the country itself was dropped (E4 fix round 1)"
			}
		}
		mod1440_wr_count_wars = yes
	}
}

# Wars: how many wars the country fights today (its open rows by their war), for the tab (E4 fix round 1).
mod1440_wr_count_wars = {
	clear_temp_array = wn_g
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_grp
		value = wn_v
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = wn_g value = wn_v } } }
			add_to_temp_array = { wn_g = wn_v }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_wars = wn_g^num }
}

# Wars: in the scope of a country, its head of government (hg_l, his place), his portrait as a text key (hg_p,
# looked up when another one rules or the table changed, kept on the country) and his ideology group (hg_g: 1
# fascism, 2 democratic, 3 communism, 4 neutrality, 0 another).
mod1440_wr_hog = {
	set_temp_variable = { hg_l = country_leader }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader } } } }
		set_temp_variable = { p_ld = country_leader }
		set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
		var:p_ld = {
			mod1440_p_leader = yes
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p = p_tok }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver = 568382 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ld_p_of = country_leader }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { hg_p = mod1440_ld_p }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { hg_p = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { hg_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { hg_g = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = fascism }
		set_temp_variable = { hg_g = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = democratic }
		set_temp_variable = { hg_g = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = communism }
		set_temp_variable = { hg_g = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = neutrality }
		set_temp_variable = { hg_g = 4 }
	}
}

# Wars: the dead of the country mod1440_wr_kv by the hand of mod1440_wr_ko, in thousands to 0.1, into kr; kr_prev is
# yesterday's reading. casualties_inflicted_by answers yes or no, so the number is searched (meta_trigger, SCR-054).
mod1440_wr_kread = {
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kn = kr_prev }
	set_temp_variable = { kr_lo = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { kr_hi = kr_prev }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { meta_trigger = { text = { [V] = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = [O] thousands > [N] } } } V = "[?mod1440_wr_kv.GetTag]" O = "[?mod1440_wr_ko.GetTag]" N = "[?mod1440_wr_kn|1]" } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { kr_prev > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kn = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { meta_trigger = { text = { [V] = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = [O] thousands > [N] } } } V = "[?mod1440_wr_kv.GetTag]" O = "[?mod1440_wr_ko.GetTag]" N = "[?mod1440_wr_kn|1]" } } }
				set_temp_variable = { kr_hi = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { kr_lo = kr_prev }
		set_temp_variable = { kr_st = 0.1 }
		set_temp_variable = { kr_up = 1 }
		while_loop_effect = {
			limit = { check_variable = { kr_up = 1 } check_variable = { kr_st < 1000000 } }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_t = kr_lo }
			add_to_temp_variable = { kr_t = kr_st }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kn = kr_t }
			if = {
				limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { [V] = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = [O] thousands > [N] } } } V = "[?mod1440_wr_kv.GetTag]" O = "[?mod1440_wr_ko.GetTag]" N = "[?mod1440_wr_kn|1]" } }
				set_temp_variable = { kr_lo = kr_t }
				multiply_temp_variable = { kr_st = 2 }
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { kr_hi = kr_t }
				set_temp_variable = { kr_up = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { kr_d = kr_hi }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { kr_d = kr_lo }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { kr_d > 0.15 } }
		set_temp_variable = { kr_t = kr_lo }
		add_to_temp_variable = { kr_t = kr_hi }
		multiply_temp_variable = { kr_t = 5 }
		round_temp_variable = kr_t
		divide_temp_variable = { kr_t = 10 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kn = kr_t }
		if = {
			limit = { meta_trigger = { text = { [V] = { casualties_inflicted_by = { opponent = [O] thousands > [N] } } } V = "[?mod1440_wr_kv.GetTag]" O = "[?mod1440_wr_ko.GetTag]" N = "[?mod1440_wr_kn|1]" } }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_lo = kr_t }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { kr_hi = kr_t }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { kr_d = kr_hi }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { kr_d = kr_lo }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { kr = kr_lo }
}

# Wars: the war with wr_c is over: its row moves to the finished wars with the end date, its length, its dead
# frozen (one more reading, the higher of it and yesterday's), how it ended and our head of government of the day.
mod1440_wr_close = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_peace }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_capitulated }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_subject }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_c = { exists = no } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_gone }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 2 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_annexed }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_capitulated = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_we_capitulated }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_c = { exists = yes } is_subject_of = var:wr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_out = token:mod1440_wr_out_we_subject }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_oc = 7 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_fr = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_oc = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_fr = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_oc > 5 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_fr = 2 }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_d = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_j }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_ku = mod1440_wr_kus^wr_j }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_kt = mod1440_wr_kthem^wr_j }
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_c = { exists = yes } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = THIS }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = wr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kus^wr_j }
			add_to_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kus0^wr_j }
			mod1440_wr_kread = yes
			set_temp_variable = { kr_v = kr }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { kr_v = mod1440_wr_kus0^wr_j }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_o = wr_ku }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { kr_v > kr_o } }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_ku = kr_v }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = wr_c }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kthem^wr_j }
			add_to_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kthem0^wr_j }
			mod1440_wr_kread = yes
			set_temp_variable = { kr_v = kr }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { kr_v = mod1440_wr_kthem0^wr_j }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_o = wr_kt }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { kr_v > kr_o } }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_kt = kr_v }
			}
		}
		mod1440_wr_hog = yes
		set_temp_variable = { wr_lu = hg_l }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_pu = hg_p }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_gu = hg_g }
		set_temp_variable = { ch_v = wr_lu }
		mod1440_ch_mark = yes
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy value = wr_c index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since value = mod1440_wr_since^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until value = global.date index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days value = wr_d index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas value = 0 index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken value = mod1440_wr_taken^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost value = mod1440_wr_lost^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome value = wr_out index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old value = mod1440_wr_old^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpt value = mod1440_wr_vpt^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpl value = mod1440_wr_vpl^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_id value = mod1440_wr_id^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_day0 value = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_ecas value = mod1440_wr_ecas^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_oc value = wr_oc index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_fr value = wr_fr index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_grp value = mod1440_wr_grp^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_how value = mod1440_wr_how^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kday value = mod1440_wr_kday^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kus value = wr_ku index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kthem value = wr_kt index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lu0 value = mod1440_wr_lu0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pu0 value = mod1440_wr_pu0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gu0 value = mod1440_wr_gu0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lu1 value = wr_lu index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pu1 value = wr_pu index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gu1 value = wr_gu index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lt0 value = mod1440_wr_lt0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pt0 value = mod1440_wr_pt0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gt0 value = mod1440_wr_gt0^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lt1 value = mod1440_wr_lt1^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pt1 value = mod1440_wr_pt1^wr_j index = 0 }
		add_to_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gt1 value = mod1440_wr_gt1^wr_j index = 0 }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_enemy index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_since index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_day0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_taken index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lost index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_days index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_cas index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_capd index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_old index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_surr index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_vpt index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_vpl index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_id index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_ecas0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_ecas index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_grp index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_how index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kday index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kus0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kthem0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kus index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_kthem index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lu0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_pu0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_gu0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lt0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_pt0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_gt0 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_lt1 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_pt1 index = wr_j }
		remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wr_gt1 index = wr_j }
		mod1440_wr_count_wars = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_enemy^num > 200 } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_last = mod1440_wo_enemy^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_last = 1 }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_enemy index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_since index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_until index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_days index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_cas index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_taken index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lost index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_outcome index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_old index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpt index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_vpl index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_id index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_day0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_ecas index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_oc index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_fr index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_grp index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_how index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kday index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kus index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_kthem index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lu0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pu0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gu0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lu1 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pu1 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gu1 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lt0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pt0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gt0 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_lt1 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_pt1 index = wr_last }
			remove_from_array = { array = mod1440_wo_gt1 index = wr_last }
		}
	}
}

# Wars: one more state taken from (wr_f = 1) or lost to (wr_f = 2) the enemy in wr_c, or one more victory
# point taken (3) or lost (4). What was taken counts also for the general on the spot (of_best, of_who), in
# this war: arrays on the officer (mod1440_ow_*), one element per row by the row's number; tr_cap 1 a capital.
mod1440_wr_count = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 1 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_taken^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 2 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_lost^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 3 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpt^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 4 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_vpl^wr_j = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wr_f = 1 } check_variable = { wr_f = 3 } } check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ow_war = mod1440_wr_id^wr_j }
			var:of_who = {
				set_temp_variable = { ow_j = -1 }
				for_each_loop = {
					array = mod1440_ow_id
					value = ow_v
					index = ow_i
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { ow_v = ow_war } }
						set_temp_variable = { ow_j = ow_i }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ow_j < 0 } }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_ow_id = ow_war }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_ow_st = 0 }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_ow_vp = 0 }
					add_to_array = { mod1440_ow_cap = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ow_j = mod1440_ow_id^num }
					subtract_from_temp_variable = { ow_j = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 1 } }
					add_to_variable = { mod1440_ow_st^ow_j = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
						add_to_variable = { mod1440_ow_cap^ow_j = 1 }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { wr_f = 3 } }
					add_to_variable = { mod1440_ow_vp^ow_j = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
mod1440_wr_annexed = {
	set_temp_variable = { wr_j = -1 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wr_v = wr_c } }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_j = wr_i }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wr_j > -1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_j = 2 }
	}
}

# Wars: the numbers of today's rows: days, each enemy's surrender progress, both sides' dead (never falling), the
# enemy's head of government when another one rules; a line in the War Diary when an enemy or the country itself
# has capitulated. The portraits kept on the rows are looked up again when the text keys' numbers moved.
mod1440_wr_daily = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_wr_grp^num
			value = rl_i
			set_temp_variable = { rl_e = mod1440_wr_enemy^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wr_lu0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_l = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pu0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wr_lt0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pt0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wr_lt1^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pt1^rl_i = p_tok }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_wo_grp^num
			value = rl_i
			set_temp_variable = { rl_e = mod1440_wo_enemy^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lu0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_l = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pu0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lu1^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_l = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pu1^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lt0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pt0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lt1^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pt1^rl_i = p_tok }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver = 568382 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = wr_v
		index = wr_i
		set_temp_variable = { wr_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { wr_d = mod1440_wr_day0^wr_i }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_days^wr_i = wr_d }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_s = 0 }
		var:wr_v = {
			set_temp_variable = { wr_s = surrender_progress }
		}
		multiply_temp_variable = { wr_s = 100 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_surr^wr_i = wr_s }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_i = 0 } var:wr_v = { has_capitulated = yes } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_capd^wr_i = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capitulated }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 5 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_v }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:wr_v = { exists = yes } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = THIS }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = wr_v }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kus^wr_i }
			add_to_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kus0^wr_i }
			mod1440_wr_kread = yes
			set_temp_variable = { kr_v = kr }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { kr_v = mod1440_wr_kus0^wr_i }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_o = mod1440_wr_kus^wr_i }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { kr_v > kr_o } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kus^wr_i = kr_v }
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kv = wr_v }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_ko = THIS }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kthem^wr_i }
			add_to_temp_variable = { kr_prev = mod1440_wr_kthem0^wr_i }
			mod1440_wr_kread = yes
			set_temp_variable = { kr_v = kr }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { kr_v = mod1440_wr_kthem0^wr_i }
			set_temp_variable = { kr_o = mod1440_wr_kthem^wr_i }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { kr_v > kr_o } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kthem^wr_i = kr_v }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { wr_cl = 0 }
			var:wr_v = {
				set_temp_variable = { wr_cl = country_leader }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { wr_ol = mod1440_wr_lt1^wr_i }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wr_cl = wr_ol } } }
				var:wr_v = {
					mod1440_wr_hog = yes
				}
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_lt1^wr_i = hg_l }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pt1^wr_i = hg_p }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_gt1^wr_i = hg_g }
				set_temp_variable = { ch_v = hg_l }
				mod1440_ch_mark = yes
			}
		}
	}
	mod1440_wr_count_wars = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = yes NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_we_capitulated }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_capitulated = no }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_capd = 0 }
	}
}

# Wars: the two lists of the page, one plate per war (mod1440_wv_* of today, mod1440_wp_* finished, newest first):
# its first enemy, how many more, its days or the year it began, both sides' dead summed over its rows. A walk over
# the rows when the page shows (rule 5).
mod1440_wr_lists = {
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_g
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_c
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_first
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_n
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_d0
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_days
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_kus
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_kthem
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_known
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_surr
	clear_array = mod1440_wv_pk
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_g
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_c
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_first
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_n
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_d0
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_year
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_kus
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_kthem
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_known
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_oc
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_fr
	clear_array = mod1440_wp_pk
	set_temp_variable = { ls_all = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wr_enemy
		value = ls_v
		index = ls_i
		set_temp_variable = { ls_g = mod1440_wr_grp^ls_i }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_j = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_wv_g
			value = ls_x
			index = ls_k
			break = ls_b
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_x = ls_g } }
				set_temp_variable = { ls_j = ls_k }
				set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_j < 0 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_g = ls_g }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_c = ls_v }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_first = mod1440_wr_id^ls_i }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_n = -1 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_d0 = mod1440_wr_day0^ls_i }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_days = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_kus = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_kthem = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_known = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_surr = mod1440_wr_surr^ls_i }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wv_pk = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_j = mod1440_wv_g^num }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { ls_j = 1 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_n^ls_j = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_u = mod1440_wr_kus^ls_i }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_t = mod1440_wr_kthem^ls_i }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_u > -1 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_kus^ls_j = ls_u }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_kthem^ls_j = ls_t }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_known^ls_j = 1 }
			add_to_temp_variable = { ls_all = ls_t }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ls_id = mod1440_wr_id^ls_i }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_f = mod1440_wv_first^ls_j }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_id < ls_f } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wv_first^ls_j = ls_id }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wv_c^ls_j = mod1440_wr_enemy^ls_i }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ls_d = mod1440_wr_day0^ls_i }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_e = mod1440_wv_d0^ls_j }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_d > -1 } OR = { check_variable = { ls_e < 0 } check_variable = { ls_d < ls_e } } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wv_d0^ls_j = ls_d }
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wo_enemy^num
		value = ls_i
		set_temp_variable = { ls_g = mod1440_wo_grp^ls_i }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_j = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 0 }
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_wv_g
			value = ls_x
			index = ls_k
			break = ls_b
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_x = ls_g } }
				set_temp_variable = { ls_j = ls_k }
				set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_j > -1 } }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_n^ls_j = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_u = mod1440_wo_kus^ls_i }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_t = mod1440_wo_kthem^ls_i }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_u > -1 } }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_kus^ls_j = ls_u }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_kthem^ls_j = ls_t }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wv_known^ls_j = 1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { ls_all = ls_t }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ls_id = mod1440_wo_id^ls_i }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_f = mod1440_wv_first^ls_j }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_id < ls_f } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wv_first^ls_j = ls_id }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wv_c^ls_j = mod1440_wo_enemy^ls_i }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ls_d = mod1440_wo_day0^ls_i }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_e = mod1440_wv_d0^ls_j }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_d > -1 } OR = { check_variable = { ls_e < 0 } check_variable = { ls_d < ls_e } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wv_d0^ls_j = ls_d }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ls_j = -1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 0 }
			for_each_loop = {
				array = mod1440_wp_g
				value = ls_x
				index = ls_k
				break = ls_b
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { ls_x = ls_g } }
					set_temp_variable = { ls_j = ls_k }
					set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_j < 0 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_g = ls_g }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_c = mod1440_wo_enemy^ls_i }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_first = mod1440_wo_id^ls_i }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_n = -1 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_d0 = mod1440_wo_day0^ls_i }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_year = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_kus = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_kthem = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_known = 0 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_oc = mod1440_wo_oc^ls_i }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_fr = mod1440_wo_fr^ls_i }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wp_pk = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ls_j = mod1440_wp_g^num }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { ls_j = 1 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wp_n^ls_j = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_u = mod1440_wo_kus^ls_i }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_t = mod1440_wo_kthem^ls_i }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_u > -1 } }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wp_kus^ls_j = ls_u }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wp_kthem^ls_j = ls_t }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wp_known^ls_j = 1 }
				add_to_temp_variable = { ls_all = ls_t }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ls_id = mod1440_wo_id^ls_i }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_f = mod1440_wp_first^ls_j }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_id < ls_f } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wp_first^ls_j = ls_id }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wp_c^ls_j = mod1440_wo_enemy^ls_i }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wp_oc^ls_j = mod1440_wo_oc^ls_i }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wp_fr^ls_j = mod1440_wo_fr^ls_i }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ls_d = mod1440_wo_day0^ls_i }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_e = mod1440_wp_d0^ls_j }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ls_d > -1 } OR = { check_variable = { ls_e < 0 } check_variable = { ls_d < ls_e } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wp_d0^ls_j = ls_d }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wv_g^num
		value = ls_j
		set_temp_variable = { ls_d = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { ls_d = mod1440_wv_d0^ls_j }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wv_days^ls_j = ls_d }
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wp_g^num
		value = ls_j
		set_temp_variable = { ls_d = mod1440_wp_d0^ls_j }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_d > -1 } }
			divide_temp_variable = { ls_d = 365 }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { ls_d = 0.499 }
			round_temp_variable = ls_d
			set_variable = { mod1440_wp_year^ls_j = ls_d }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kthem_all = ls_all }
	mod1440_wr_picks = yes
}
mod1440_wr_picks = {
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wv_g^num
		value = pk_j
		set_temp_variable = { pk_g = mod1440_wv_g^pk_j }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wv_pk^pk_j = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pk_g = mod1440_wr_sel_g } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wv_pk^pk_j = 1 }
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wp_g^num
		value = pk_j
		set_temp_variable = { pk_g = mod1440_wp_g^pk_j }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wp_pk^pk_j = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { pk_g = mod1440_wr_sel_g } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wp_pk^pk_j = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Wars: what the page needs when it is on show. With no war chosen, or one that is no more, the file opens on the
# first war there is.
mod1440_wr_show = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	mod1440_wr_lists = yes
	set_temp_variable = { sh_a = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wv_g
		value = ls_x
		index = ls_k
		break = ls_b
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_x = mod1440_wr_sel_g } }
			set_temp_variable = { sh_a = ls_k }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 1 }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { sh_b = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_wp_g
		value = ls_x
		index = ls_k
		break = ls_b
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ls_x = mod1440_wr_sel_g } }
			set_temp_variable = { sh_b = ls_k }
			set_temp_variable = { ls_b = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { sh_a < 0 } check_variable = { sh_b < 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_e = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wv_g^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_g = mod1440_wv_g^0 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wp_g^num > 0 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_g = mod1440_wp_g^0 }
		}
		mod1440_wr_picks = yes
	}
	mod1440_wr_card = yes
}

# Wars: the file of the chosen war (mod1440_wr_sel_g): its rows in the order they joined (mod1440_we_*, the enemies
# table), the war's figures, our heads of government, the War Diary's lines about its enemies within its dates,
# the marks of the track and the commanders' tally over its rows.
mod1440_wr_card = {
	mod1440_wr_grow = yes
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_wr_grp^num
			value = rl_i
			set_temp_variable = { rl_e = mod1440_wr_enemy^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wr_lu0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_l = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pu0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wr_lt0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pt0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wr_lt1^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_pt1^rl_i = p_tok }
		}
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_wo_grp^num
			value = rl_i
			set_temp_variable = { rl_e = mod1440_wo_enemy^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lu0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_l = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pu0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lu1^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_l = {
					mod1440_p_leader = yes
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pu1^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lt0^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pt0^rl_i = p_tok }
			set_temp_variable = { rl_l = mod1440_wo_lt1^rl_i }
			set_temp_variable = { p_tok = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { rl_l = 0 } } }
				var:rl_e = {
					if = {
						limit = { exists = yes }
						var:rl_l = {
							mod1440_p_leader = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wo_pt1^rl_i = p_tok }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver = 568382 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_has = 0 }
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_k_0_ul
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_k_1_ul
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_k_2_ul
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_k_3_ul
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_k_4_ul
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = THIS }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_te = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_te = THIS }
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_we_c
	clear_array = mod1440_we_id
	clear_array = mod1440_we_open
	clear_array = mod1440_we_idx
	clear_array = mod1440_we_since
	clear_array = mod1440_we_until
	clear_array = mod1440_we_day0
	clear_array = mod1440_we_end
	clear_array = mod1440_we_oc
	clear_array = mod1440_we_surr
	clear_array = mod1440_we_capd
	clear_array = mod1440_we_kus
	clear_array = mod1440_we_kthem
	clear_array = mod1440_we_st
	clear_array = mod1440_we_sl
	clear_array = mod1440_we_vpt
	clear_array = mod1440_we_vpl
	clear_array = mod1440_we_old
	clear_array = mod1440_we_odd
	clear_array = mod1440_we_pk
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_t_id
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_t_open
	clear_array = mod1440_wr_t_idx
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wr_enemy^num
		value = cd_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_grp^cd_i = mod1440_wr_sel_g } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_t_id = mod1440_wr_id^cd_i }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_t_open = 1 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_t_idx = cd_i }
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = mod1440_wo_enemy^num
		value = cd_i
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wo_grp^cd_i = mod1440_wr_sel_g } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_t_id = mod1440_wo_id^cd_i }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_t_open = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_t_idx = cd_i }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cd_n = mod1440_wr_t_id^num }
	set_temp_variable = { cd_odd = 0 }
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = cd_n
		value = cd_k
		find_lowest_in_array = {
			array = mod1440_wr_t_id
			value = cd_lo
			index = cd_at
		}
		set_temp_variable = { cd_o = mod1440_wr_t_open^cd_at }
		set_temp_variable = { cd_x = mod1440_wr_t_idx^cd_at }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_t_id^cd_at = 2000000 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cd_o = 1 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_c = mod1440_wr_enemy^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_id = mod1440_wr_id^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_open = 1 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_idx = cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_since = mod1440_wr_since^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_until = global.date }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_day0 = mod1440_wr_day0^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_end = global.num_days }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_oc = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_surr = mod1440_wr_surr^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_capd = mod1440_wr_capd^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_kus = mod1440_wr_kus^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_kthem = mod1440_wr_kthem^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_st = mod1440_wr_taken^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_sl = mod1440_wr_lost^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_vpt = mod1440_wr_vpt^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_vpl = mod1440_wr_vpl^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_old = mod1440_wr_old^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_odd = cd_odd }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_pk = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cd_end = -1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cd_d = mod1440_wo_day0^cd_x }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cd_d > -1 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cd_end = cd_d }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cd_end = mod1440_wo_days^cd_x }
			}
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_c = mod1440_wo_enemy^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_id = mod1440_wo_id^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_open = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_idx = cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_since = mod1440_wo_since^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_until = mod1440_wo_until^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_day0 = mod1440_wo_day0^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_end = cd_end }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_oc = mod1440_wo_oc^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_surr = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_capd = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_kus = mod1440_wo_kus^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_kthem = mod1440_wo_kthem^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_st = mod1440_wo_taken^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_sl = mod1440_wo_lost^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_vpt = mod1440_wo_vpt^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_vpl = mod1440_wo_vpl^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_old = mod1440_wo_old^cd_x }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_odd = cd_odd }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_we_pk = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cd_odd = 0 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cd_odd = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { cd_odd = 0 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cd_n > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_has = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_count = cd_n }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_n = cd_n }
		subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_n = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_enemy = mod1440_we_c^0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_since = mod1440_we_since^0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_old = mod1440_we_old^0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_id = mod1440_we_id^0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_open = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_kus = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_kthem = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_taken = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_lost = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_vpt = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_vpl = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_gave = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_kunk = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_day0 = -1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_endday = -1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_until = mod1440_we_until^0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cd_last = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { cd_known = 0 }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = cd_n
			value = cd_k
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_we_open^cd_k = 1 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_open = 1 }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cd_d = mod1440_we_day0^cd_k }
			set_temp_variable = { cd_e = mod1440_wr_c_day0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cd_d > -1 } OR = { check_variable = { cd_e < 0 } check_variable = { cd_d < cd_e } } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_day0 = cd_d }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { cd_d = mod1440_we_end^cd_k }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cd_d > mod1440_wr_c_endday } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_endday = cd_d }
				set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_until = mod1440_we_until^cd_k }
				set_temp_variable = { cd_last = cd_k }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_we_kus^cd_k > -1 } }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_kus = mod1440_we_kus^cd_k }
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_kthem = mod1440_we_kthem^cd_k }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cd_known = 1 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_taken = mod1440_we_st^cd_k }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_lost = mod1440_we_sl^cd_k }
