				index = kt_at
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_3 = mod1440_wr_kt_c^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_3_st = mod1440_wr_kt_st^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_3_vp = mod1440_wr_kt_vp^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_3_cap = mod1440_wr_kt_cap^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kt_score^kt_at = -1 }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_n = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { kt_ul = 0 }
			var:mod1440_wr_k_3 = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { kt_ul = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
						mod1440_p_officer = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
						set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
						set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
					}
					set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_3_p = mod1440_p }
				}
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_3_rank = 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { is_field_marshal = yes }
					set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_3_rank = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_3_rank = 3 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { kt_ul = 1 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_k_3_ul = mod1440_wr_k_3 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4 = country_leader }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_st = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_vp = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_cap = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_rank = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_kt_score^num > 4 } }
			find_highest_in_array = {
				array = mod1440_wr_kt_score
				value = kt_hi
				index = kt_at
			}
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4 = mod1440_wr_kt_c^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_st = mod1440_wr_kt_st^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_vp = mod1440_wr_kt_vp^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_cap = mod1440_wr_kt_cap^kt_at }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_kt_score^kt_at = -1 }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_n = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { kt_ul = 0 }
			var:mod1440_wr_k_4 = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { kt_ul = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
						mod1440_p_officer = yes
					}
					if = {
						limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
						set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
						set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
						set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
					}
					set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_4_p = mod1440_p }
				}
				set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_4_rank = 2 }
				if = {
					limit = { is_field_marshal = yes }
					set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_4_rank = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_navy_leader = yes }
					set_variable = { PREV.mod1440_wr_k_4_rank = 3 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { kt_ul = 1 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_k_4_ul = mod1440_wr_k_4 }
			}
		}
	}
	for_loop_effect = {
		start = 0
		end = 31
		value = pad_n
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_ln_date^num < 31 } }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_date = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_day = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_kind = token:mod1440_blank }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_fam = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_a = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_sa = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_p = 0 }
			add_to_array = { mod1440_wr_ln_b = THIS }
		}
	}
}
mod1440_wr_faces_u = {
	set_temp_variable = { fc_unk = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up0 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up0 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ufb0 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up0 = fc_unk } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ufb0 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_unr0 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ul0 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_unr0 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up1 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ufb1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up1 = fc_unk } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ufb1 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_unr1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ul1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_unr1 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_utw = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fc_a = mod1440_wr_c_ul0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fc_b = mod1440_wr_c_ul1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fc_a = fc_b } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_utw = 1 }
	}
}

# Wars: their side of the file: the heads of government of the enemy chosen in the table (mod1440_wr_sel_e).
mod1440_wr_them = {
	set_temp_variable = { th_k = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { th_b = 0 }
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_we_id
		value = th_v
		index = th_i
		break = th_b
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { th_v = mod1440_wr_sel_e } }
			set_temp_variable = { th_k = th_i }
			set_temp_variable = { th_b = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { th_k < 0 } check_variable = { mod1440_we_id^num > 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { th_k = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_sel_e = mod1440_we_id^0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { th_k > -1 } }
		for_loop_effect = {
			start = 0
			end = mod1440_we_pk^num
			value = th_i
			set_variable = { mod1440_we_pk^th_i = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_we_pk^th_k = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_te = mod1440_we_c^th_k }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_topen = mod1440_we_open^th_k }
		set_temp_variable = { th_x = mod1440_we_idx^th_k }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_topen = 1 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tl0 = mod1440_wr_lt0^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tl1 = mod1440_wr_lt1^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = mod1440_wr_pt0^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = mod1440_wr_pt1^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tg0 = mod1440_wr_gt0^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tg1 = mod1440_wr_gt1^th_x }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tl0 = mod1440_wo_lt0^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tl1 = mod1440_wo_lt1^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = mod1440_wo_pt0^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = mod1440_wo_pt1^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tg0 = mod1440_wo_gt0^th_x }
			set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tg1 = mod1440_wo_gt1^th_x }
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { fc_unk = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tfb0 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = fc_unk } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tfb0 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tnr0 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tl0 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tnr0 = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tfb1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = fc_unk } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tfb1 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tnr1 = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tl1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tnr1 = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ttw = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fc_a = mod1440_wr_c_tl0 }
	set_temp_variable = { fc_b = mod1440_wr_c_tl1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { fc_a = fc_b } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_ttw = 1 }
	}
}

# The Records: what the window shows. Sets the buttons' frames and makes the list of the open page.
mod1440_rec_show = {
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_of_c_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_of_c_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_gv_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_gv_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up0 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up0 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_up1 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp0 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_c_tp1 = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_0_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_0_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_1_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_1_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_2_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_2_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_3_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_3_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_p = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wr_k_4_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_state = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_state = capital }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_last_s = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_last_s = capital }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_wd_country = 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_wd_country = THIS }
	}
	mod1440_rec_odd = yes
	set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_cap = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_cap = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_sea = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_sea = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_sea = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_air = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_air = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_air = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_vp = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_vp = 1 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_f_vp = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_days = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_rec_days = mod1440_ev_since_day }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 0 } }
		mod1440_wd_list = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 1 } }
		mod1440_of_list = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 2 } }
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_page = 3 } }
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
		mod1440_wr_daily = yes
		mod1440_wr_show = yes
	}
	add_to_variable = { mod1440_rec_dirty = 1 }
}

# The Records: the window closes; the lines written so far count as seen (the badge of the top bar button).
mod1440_rec_close = {
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_new = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_new_war = 0 }
	set_variable = { mod1440_rec_seen = mod1440_ln_next }
}

# The Records: the first run for the country in scope. Takes the copies the daily comparison needs, opens a
# row for each war that already runs and writes the first line.
mod1440_ev_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.mod1440_sr_named = 1 } } }
		every_state = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = mod1440_sr_from } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_from = PREV }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.mod1440_sr_named = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_begun = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_since = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_since_day = global.num_days }
		mod1440_rec_odd = yes
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_begins }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
		for_each_loop = {
			array = enemies
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_how = 0 }
			mod1440_wr_open = yes
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = subjects
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_subjects = ev_c }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in }
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
		mod1440_gv_daily = yes
		mod1440_of_seen = yes
	}
}

# The Records: once a day for a player's country. The victory points first, while yesterday's enemies are
# still known. Then what no hook tells, found by comparing with yesterday: the end of a war, a new or lost
# subject, the faction, the offices. Then the numbers of the wars, and how long each state taken is held.
mod1440_rec_daily = {
	mod1440_ev_init = yes
	mod1440_ev_grow = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		mod1440_vp_scan = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_vp_ver = 0 }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = enemies
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_with }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 3 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { wr_how = 3 }
			mod1440_wr_open = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ev_enemies
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = enemies value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_peace }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 4 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			set_temp_variable = { wr_c = ev_c }
			mod1440_wr_close = yes
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_ev_enemies
	for_each_loop = {
		array = enemies
		value = ev_c
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = ev_c }
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = subjects
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_subjects value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_subject_new }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 8 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	for_each_loop = {
		array = mod1440_ev_subjects
		value = ev_c
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = ev_c } } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_subject_gone }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 9 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
	}
	clear_array = mod1440_ev_subjects
	for_each_loop = {
		array = subjects
		value = ev_c
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_subjects = ev_c }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_in_faction = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_in = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_in = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_faction_in }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = faction_leader }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_faction_out }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 11 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
		}
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_fac = ev_in }
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
	}
	else = {
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_gv_fac value = ev_c } } }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = subjects value = ev_c } } }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_member_in }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 12 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
					mod1440_ev_add = yes
				}
			}
		}
		for_each_loop = {
			array = mod1440_gv_fac
			value = ev_c
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = faction_members value = ev_c } } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_member_out }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 13 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = ev_c }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
				mod1440_ev_add = yes
			}
		}
		clear_array = mod1440_gv_fac
		for_each_loop = {
			array = faction_members
			value = ev_c
			add_to_array = { mod1440_gv_fac = ev_c }
		}
	}
	mod1440_wr_daily = yes
	mod1440_gv_daily = yes
	mod1440_of_seen = yes
	mod1440_of_gone = yes
	set_temp_variable = { ev_ck = casualties_k }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_v = 1 } } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_v = 1 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 9 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 24 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 49 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 99 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 249 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 499 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 999 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 1999 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ev_ck > 4999 } }
			set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 9 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 0 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 9 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 10 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 1 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 24 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 25 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 2 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 49 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 50 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 3 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 99 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 4 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 100 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 4 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 249 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 5 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 250 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 5 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 499 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 500 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 6 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 999 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 7 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 1000 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 7 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 1999 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 8 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 2000 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 8 } check_variable = { ev_ck > 4999 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_ev_cas_i = 9 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_casualties }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 51 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 5000 }
		mod1440_ev_add = yes
	}
	every_controlled_state = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_sr_day > 0 } }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_held = global.num_days }
		subtract_from_variable = { mod1440_sr_held = mod1440_sr_day }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_sr_has_by = 1 } }
			clear_array = mod1440_sr_by_ul
			set_temp_variable = { sr_ul = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { sr_ul_c = mod1440_sr_by }
			var:sr_ul_c = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_unit_leader = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { sr_ul = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { sr_ul = 1 } }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_sr_by_ul = mod1440_sr_by }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_rec_open = 1 } }
		mod1440_rec_show = yes
	}
}

# The Records: a war has begun between the country in scope and wr_c (a hook says who attacked).
mod1440_ev_war_on = {
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_on }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
	mod1440_ev_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wr_how = 1 }
	mod1440_wr_open = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = wr_c }
	}
}
mod1440_ev_war_by = {
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_war_by }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 2 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_a = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_b = wr_c }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
	mod1440_ev_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wr_old = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { wr_how = 2 }
	mod1440_wr_open = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = mod1440_ev_enemies value = wr_c } } }
		add_to_array = { mod1440_ev_enemies = wr_c }
	}
}

# The Records: the general of the country in scope with the most divisions in the state tr_s: of_who, and
# of_best how many divisions that is (0: nobody stands there).
mod1440_of_best = {
	set_temp_variable = { of_best = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { of_who = 0 }
	every_army_leader = {
		set_temp_variable = { of_n = num_units_in_state@var:tr_s }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_n > of_best } }
			mod1440_of_me = yes
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { of_me = 0 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { of_best = of_n }
				set_temp_variable = { of_who = of_me }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The Records: the country in scope has taken the state tr_s from tr_c (tr_cap = 1: a capital). At war with
# tr_c: a line with the general on the spot, the count of the war and his own, what the state card shows, and the
# honour. Not at war (an annexation, a subject's state, a peace): a line of the territory log only, "Received
# from", nothing counted for a war or an officer, and the card says it came by treaty (E1 review, 2026-10-22).
mod1440_tr_taken = {
	var:tr_s = {
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_date = global.date }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_day = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_from = tr_c }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_held = 0 }
		set_variable = { mod1440_sr_how = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war_with = var:tr_c }
		mod1440_of_best = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_taken }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 16 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 1 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_taken }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_c = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 1 }
		mod1440_wr_count = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			var:of_who = {
				add_to_variable = { mod1440_of_states = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { sr_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
			var:of_who = {
				if = {
					limit = { is_unit_leader = yes OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
					mod1440_p_officer = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 } } NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep } } } }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p = token:GFX_portrait_unknown }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver = 568382 }
					set_variable = { mod1440_p_ver_ep = global.mod1440_tk_ep }
				}
				set_temp_variable = { sr_p = mod1440_p }
			}
		}
		var:tr_s = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_sr_has_by = 0 }
			clear_array = mod1440_sr_by_ul
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_by = of_who }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_by_p = sr_p }
				set_variable = { mod1440_sr_has_by = 1 }
				add_to_array = { mod1440_sr_by_ul = of_who }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } check_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto = 1 } has_dlc = "By Blood Alone" }
			var:tr_s = {
				set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
				every_state_division = {
					limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
					add_history_entry = {
						key = mod1440_hn_capture
						subject = "Capital"
						allow = no
					}
					add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
				}
			}
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
			add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto_n = hn_n }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_received }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 39 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
		var:tr_s = {
			set_variable = { mod1440_sr_how = 2 }
			set_variable = { mod1440_sr_has_by = 0 }
		}
	}
}
mod1440_tr_lost = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_war_with = var:tr_c }
		mod1440_of_best = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { tr_cap = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_capital_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 17 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 1 }
			mod1440_ev_add = yes
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_lost }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 15 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { of_best > 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = of_who }
			}
			set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
			mod1440_tr_add = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { wr_c = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { wr_f = 2 }
		mod1440_wr_count = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kind = token:mod1440_ev_state_handed }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 40 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_a = tr_s }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 1 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_b = tr_c }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
		set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
		mod1440_tr_add = yes
	}
}

# The Records: a victory point worth 15 or more taken (mod1440_vp_changed): the honour of the divisions of the
# country in scope that stand in its state vp_s, when that switch is on.
mod1440_hn_city = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_vp = 1 } has_dlc = "By Blood Alone" }
		var:vp_s = {
			set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
			every_state_division = {
				limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
				add_history_entry = {
					key = mod1440_hn_city
					subject = "City"
					allow = no
				}
				add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto_n = hn_n }
	}
}

# The Records: a landing from the sea (on_naval_invasion: the state in scope, ROOT the country that lands) and
# from the air (on_units_paradropped_in_state: ROOT the state, FROM the country). The honour of the divisions of
# the player that stand in the state when the hook fires.
mod1440_hn_landing = {
	set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
	every_state_division = {
		limit = { OWNER = { tag = ROOT } }
		add_history_entry = {
			key = mod1440_hn_sea
			subject = "Landing"
			allow = no
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
	}
	ROOT = {
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto_n = hn_n }
	}
}
mod1440_hn_drop = {
	set_temp_variable = { hn_n = 0 }
	every_state_division = {
		limit = { OWNER = { tag = FROM } }
		add_history_entry = {
			key = mod1440_hn_air
			subject = "Airborne"
			allow = no
		}
		add_to_temp_variable = { hn_n = 1 }
	}
	FROM = {
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_count = hn_n }
		add_to_variable = { mod1440_hn_auto_n = hn_n }
	}
}
